answer_1.quote: In this work, we propose Targeted Data Generation (TDG), a framework to automatically identify challenging subgroups that can benefit from more data, and then generate that data with LLMs
answer_1.outputs: additional examples for identified challenging clusters

answer_2.quote: We evaluate TDG on three tasks: sentiment analysis (SST), paraphrase detection (QQP), and natural language inference (MNLI).

answer_4.quote: We recruited 12 users to label GPT-3 generated data in the subgroup augmentation step.
